summary.json.scope: No-merge nonoverlap shortcuts, explicit scratch copy, deferred leaf initialization and combinations with parent zero-distance candidate.
summary.json.conditions: CPU16 Intel14900K E core, per-CPU lock; gcc15.2 O2 with/without native and Clang21 O2 baseline; compiler CPU6; five rotated repetitions; same bench generation outside timing, copy/allocation/solve/free and checksum inside. Concurrency on other cores; source/IO same.
summary.json.deferred_proof: Before interval entry global nodes_ within it retains original x order: prior visited sibling operations touch only disjoint subranges, and parent merge/strip waits for both children. Saving split_x from nodes_[middle] thus reads original x. Leaves whose output==nodes_.data() already contain their original x input; other leaves copy that untouched subrange into buffer output. Every child then initializes its output, which is parent merge input. All intervals are fully initialized before reads and all zero-return ancestors skip merge. Sized/unsized ownership/capacity checks unaffected.

deferred_tests.configs: GCC checked/skip x normal/standard65bit, four existing tests

summary.json.recommendation: No recommended copy/ordered candidate. ordered shortcut benefits vertical/collinear but adds1–3% GCC no-native random costs. Mere resize+copy little benefit. Deferred copy proves safe but native random/sorted often1–3% slower, no broad win. Deferred+zero can win GCC1–3% extra but Clangirregulargrid+3.9%,clusters+2.8% andduplicatefirst+5.8%. Parent standalone zero_distance is most robust small candidate: native vertical7–8%,grid5% faster, other modes mostly near±1%; Clang some0–2% regressions should be considered separately.

decisions.reuse_dy: 帯域内のdy二乗再利用を明示した案は主に±1%で利益が小さく不採用。既存コードからコンパイラが再利用できる場合もある。
decisions.ordered_copy: 非交差なy区間のmerge省略は一部で利点があるが、他条件で約1～4%後退し不採用。
decisions.deferred: 未訪問nodes_の元x順を保持する帰納的不変条件で、初回全面コピーを葉まで遅らせる案は正しい。ただしGCC nativeの大規模で約1～3%後退、zeroと組合せもClang不規則格子約4%後退があり不採用。
decisions.zero_all_compilers: GCCで明確な利点がある一方、Clangの500000点水平で約28%後退（他の点数では改善もある）。すべてのコンパイラで同じ式へ置換する案は不採用。
decisions.zero_gcc: GCCだけ採用。Clangは4構成のbench機械語.textがbaselineと完全一致。GCCの5構成は測定したzero_distance候補と.text一致。

simd: 追加なし。前回までに検討したSIMD leafの他条件での後退は解消しておらず採用していない。

from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent;s=(p/'baseline.hpp').read_text()
old='    void update(const Node& a, const Node& b) {\n        const auto d = distance(a, b);';assert s.count(old)==1
v=s.replace(old,'    void update(const Node& a, const Node& b, Distance d) {')
old='update(output[i], output[j]);';assert v.count(old)==1;v=v.replace(old,'update(output[i], output[j], distance(output[i], output[j]));')
old='''                if (!(square(difference(current.y, previous.y)) < best_)) break;
                update(current, previous);''';new='''                const auto dy2 = square(difference(current.y, previous.y));
                if (!(dy2 < best_)) break;
                update(current, previous, add(square(difference(current.x, previous.x)), dy2));''';assert v.count(old)==1;v=v.replace(old,new);(p/'reuse_dy.hpp').write_text(v)
old='zero_ = a.x == b.x && a.y == b.y;';assert s.count(old)==1;(p/'zero_distance.hpp').write_text(s.replace(old,'zero_ = !(square(0) < d);'));(p/'combined.hpp').write_text(v.replace(old,'zero_ = !(square(0) < d);'))
(p/'bench.cpp').write_bytes(Path('/tmp/sirkit_nearest_strip_20261024/bench.cpp').read_bytes())
s=Path('/tmp/sirkit_nearest_strip_20261024/bench.py').read_text().replace("vs=['baseline','ring','ring_separate']","vs=['baseline','reuse_dy','zero_distance','combined']").replace('range(5)','range(7)');(p/'bench.py').write_text(s)

identity.py.source:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib
p=Path(__file__).parent;sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();records=[]
for cc,compiler in [('gcc',['/usr/bin/g++']),('clang',['clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15'])]:
 for skip,standard,native in [(False,False,False),(True,False,False),(False,True,False),(True,True,False),*([(True,False,True)]if cc=='gcc'else[])]:
  flags=['-std=c++23','-O2',*(['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']if skip else []),*(['-DSIRKIT_FORCE_STANDARD_ARITHMETIC','-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD','-U__SIZEOF_INT128__']if standard else []),*(['-march=native']if native else [])]
  expected='zero_distance'if cc=='gcc'else'baseline';hashes={};commands=[]
  for variant in [expected,'adopted']:
   exe=p/'identity';text=p/'identity.text';cmd=['taskset','-c','6',*compiler,*flags,'-DHEADER="'+str(p/(variant+'.hpp'))+'"',str(p/'bench.cpp'),'-o',str(exe)];subprocess.run(cmd,check=True,capture_output=True);subprocess.run(['objcopy','--dump-section','.text='+str(text),str(exe)],check=True,capture_output=True);hashes[variant]=sha(text.read_bytes());commands.append(cmd)
  assert hashes[expected]==hashes['adopted'],(cc,flags,hashes)
  records.append({'compiler':cc,'skip':skip,'standard':standard,'native':native,'expected':expected,'text_hashes':hashes,'commands':commands});print(cc,skip,standard,native,'text byte identity PASS',flush=True)
(p/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
